* ✨ Add LaTeX support
* ✨ Add diagram support
* ✨ Add code highlight support
* ✨ Add insert table/diagram/formula support
* 🔧 Fix relaunch unavailable

name: Typability 0.2.0
body:
## What's Changed
* ✨ Add Find/Replace support
* ✨ Add Syntax Option
* ✨ Add Vibrancy Option
* ✨ Ensure doc saved before editor closed
* 🔧 Fix display issue on Linux/macOS
* 🔧 Fix saving when no file path assigned
* 🔧 Upgraded the minimum supported macOS version to 11.3
* 🦷 Update a new icon. by @SoilZhu in https://github.com/SimonShiki/Typability/pull/1

## New Contributors
* @SoilZhu made their first contribution in https://github.com/SimonShiki/Typability/pull/1
